message.text:
The four dispatch functions are:

- DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
- DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
- DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
- DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook

They are defined in memo_service_webhooks.go.

They converge on `webhook.PostAsync` or `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`. The comment-created path also calls `webhook.PostAsync`.
I'll re-read the webhook dispatch functions and where they converge for delivery.

Two memo lifecycle events have been identified so far. Created events dispatch through `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` and `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` before reaching `webhook.PostAsync`. Updated events follow the same pattern via `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` and `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` to `webhook.PostAsync`. The analysis is still incomplete.

Deleted memos dispatch through `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` and `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` to `webhook.PostAsync`. Comment creation dispatches directly through `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` to `webhook.PostAsync`. All four events converge on `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`.

q30.
memo created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook
memo updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook
memo deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook
memo comment created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook
webhook.PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go

All four are in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. Created/updated/deleted go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; comment-created posts in its own loop. Every path calls `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`), which queues into `Post` for HTTP delivery.
